entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: God damn! Talk about a mess!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's broken... Well, I guess it would be[n]a little more precise to say we broke it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We can't get through like this![n]What're we gonna do!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Perhaps we could walk over the giant[n]boulders? Let's try it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, you kiddin' me? The boulders[n]are stuck, so we can't get out...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It'll be impossible to pass through this[n]way. We'll have to find another path.
